You’ll guide them with clarity and compassion - no cold calls or pushy tactics, just meaningful conversations that help people make one of life’s most important decisions with confidence.</p> <p>This is a sales role: you're responsible for helping families make confident decisions and guiding them to a close - always with genuine care, never pressure. Depending on team needs and performance, this role may include a mix of inbound sales conversations, returning lead follow-up, and support work that helps the broader sales process run smoothly.</p> <p><em>A quick note, because many candidates wonder about it:&nbsp;</em>People often assume this work is emotionally heavy, but our team consistently finds it deeply meaningful and surprisingly uplifting. The role is rooted in hospitality, clarity, and human connection, not sadness. Rather than feeling heavy, the work offers a unique sense of purpose as part of a modern, compassionate company transforming an outdated industry and bringing dignity, transparency, and warmth to families across the country.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>Grow Your Career</h3> <p>Most teammates begin in our&nbsp;<strong>Second Call Representative</strong>&nbsp;role, a customer-facing sales position where you'll build product expertise, close deals, and develop our consultative sales approach.</p> <p>High-performing Day Shift reps may become eligible to join our&nbsp;<strong>First Call Representative</strong>&nbsp;team after approximately three months. First Call Reps receive more inbound opportunities and move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan tied directly to dollars sold, creating meaningful upside for top performers.</p> <p>Eligibility for the First Call team is based on sustained performance, including strong conversion results, customer experience, workflow accuracy, and overall reliability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Handle warm inbound leads and support families through the sales process with clarity, empathy, and strong follow-through.</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide families through cremation options, helping them make a confident decision when possible and ensuring thoughtful follow-up when more time is needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage returning leads and follow-up conversations across phone, text, and email so no family falls through the cracks.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to queue coverage, sales activities, and related support workflows that improve the overall customer experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hit performance targets while maintaining strong conversion outcomes and quality scores.</p> </li> <li> <p>Move fluently across our stack - HubSpot, Aircall, GSuite, Slack, and our case management system.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Must currently reside in Latin America, the Caribbean, or the Philippines.</li> <li> <p>2+ years of sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding individual targets - managing the full sales cycle and closing, ideally consumer (B2C) sales over the phone.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong sales instincts and phone presence: you can guide a live conversation toward a confident decision, handle objections naturally, and build trust with families while balancing sales conversations with follow-up and support work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear spoken and written English; you explain options simply and warmly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Self-driven and results-focused: you track where you stand against your target and adjust when you're behind. Emotionally steady and highly coachable</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable working independently and managing a consistent follow-up rhythm.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRMs (Salesforce, Zoho, etc.).</p> </li> <li> <p>A home setup that supports the work - see our&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Iap_48WyBpiBL098Y7EC15a26syH7C9vfeXk_FAcOVI/edit?usp=sharing">tech requirements</a>&nbsp;for details.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus Points</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience selling in high-trust categories (insurance, healthcare, travel, etc.).</p> </li> <li> <p>Spanish fluency — many of the families we serve speak it.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Details:</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Remote, full-time</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong> $6-$14 OTE, depending on your location and local market.</p> <ul> <li> <p><em>Competitive base pay plus monthly performance bonuses.</em></p> </li> <li> <p><em>The advertised OTE reflects expected earnings in your starting role. Top performers who advance to our&nbsp;<strong>First Call Representative</strong>&nbsp;team move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan with significantly higher earning potential.</em></p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Tools</strong>: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Schedule:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Full-time, 8-hour shifts on a consistent weekly schedule</p> </li> <li> <p>Days: Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday, or Sunday–Thursday</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>(weekend availability a plus)</strong></p> </li> <li> <p>Available shift windows:</p> <ul> <li> <p>AM (start 6–8am EST)</p> </li> <li> <p>PM (start 1–4pm EST)</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3>Why You’ll Love Working With Us:</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>We’re a real business, built to last.</strong>&nbsp;We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.</p> <p><strong>This is not a conventional graphic-design role.</strong> We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools.</p> <p>You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials.</p> <h3>The work</h3> <p>You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals.</p> <p>Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell.</p> <ul> <li>Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents.</li> <li>Decide what each batch should test and why.</li> <li>Source and analyse strong visual and structural references.</li> <li>Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction.</li> <li>Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads.</li> <li>Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level.</li> <li>Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop.</li> <li>Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance.</li> <li>Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output.</li> <li>Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests.</li> <li>Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch.</li> </ul> <h3>What you must be good at</h3> <ul> <li>Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy</li> <li>Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation</li> <li>Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit</li> <li>Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page</li> <li>Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production</li> <li>Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation</li> <li>Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools</li> <li>Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish</li> <li>Fast, organised batch production</li> <li>Reading creative performance and choosing the next test</li> </ul> <h3>You are probably not right for this role if</h3> <ul> <li>Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context.</li> <li>You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism.</li> <li>You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work.</li> <li>You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision.</li> <li>You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production.</li> <li>You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples.</li> <li>You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <p>Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at <strong>USD $2,000</strong>. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay <strong>USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month</strong>, based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator.</p> <p>We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output.</p> <h3>How to apply</h3> <p><strong>Do not send a generic cover letter.</strong> Message Simon on WhatsApp at <strong>+353 86 349 5073</strong> and begin with: <strong>I make the work.</strong></p> <ol> <li>Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed.</li> <li>For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel.</li> <li>Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable.</li> <li>Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed.</li> <li>List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset.</li> <li>Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test.</li> <li>State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial.</li> </ol> <p>Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial.</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer</a></p&g
